name: Hack Squat Calf Raise
steps: Set your shoulders under the pads and place the balls of both feet securely on the footplate with your heels clear.
Support the sled, release the catches and keep your knees slightly bent.
Lower your heels slowly toward the bottom of the platform until you feel a full stretch in your calves.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause and lower your heels with control before engaging the catches to finish.
tips: Keep your knees stationary so the movement comes entirely from your ankles rather than bouncing with your quads.
Pause briefly at the bottom stretch to eliminate momentum between repetitions.
